description: Dictionary + global/high-priority i18n. Add ALL new VI/EN dictionary keys (for this feature AND FEAT-002) to assets/js/i18n.js so i18n.js has a single editor and the two features never race on it. Then fix the user's screenshot page (product-detail.js + product-detail.html) and the globally-shared components (shared-components.js header/footer/search/AI chat) and product-reviews.js. Independent of FEAT-002 at the file level except that FEAT-002 depends on the keys added here; run FEAT-001 first.
steps: Read context.json and this file FIRST. Open assets/js/products.js to copy the exact `function t(key, fallback)` helper pattern; open assets/js/product-reviews.js to see its existing `text(key, fallback)` helper.

In assets/js/i18n.js dictionary object, add every key from plan.md's 'Dictionary additions' section (detail.*, header.*, search.*, chat.*, cart.*, checkout.*, orders.*, profile.*, common.*, contact.loginToSubmit), each with vi AND en, placed in its matching namespace block. Also UPDATE existing detail.rating to {vi:'Chạm vào sao để đánh giá:', en:'Tap a star to rate:'}. Do not duplicate keys that already exist (e.g. products.contactPrice, products.defaultName, products.outOfStock, products.unavailable, detail.addToCart, detail.favourites, detail.submitReview).

product-detail.js: in updateFavoriteButton() replace '\u2665 Saved'/'\u2661 Favourites' with SugarI18n.translate('detail.saved')/'detail.favourites' + fallbacks '♥ Saved'/'♥ Favourites'. In toggleFavoriteDetail() replace 'Removing...'/'Saving...' with detail.favRemoving/detail.favSaving. In fetchProductDetail() render expiration as `${n} ${translate('detail.daysUnit')}` (fallback 'days'), keep weight `${n}g`; replace fallbacks 'Liên hệ'->products.contactPrice, 'Chưa có mô tả cho sản phẩm này.'->detail.descEmpty, 'Đang cập nhật'->detail.updating, 'Lỗi: URL thiếu ID sản phẩm!'->detail.errMissingId, 'Lỗi dữ liệu: '->detail.errData. In fetchRelatedProducts() 'Không có sản phẩm gợi ý nào.'->detail.relatedEmpty, 'Sugar Bliss Product'->products.defaultName. In addProductToCart() 'Adding...'->detail.adding, 'Added to Cart'->detail.added. Add a local t(key, fallback) helper.

product-detail.js re-translation: extend the existing window.addEventListener('sugarbliss:lang-changed', syncProductAvailability) (or add a reRenderDetail()) so that when currentProduct is loaded it also refreshes the favourite button label and the weight/exp/ingredients/description FALLBACK strings and the related-products empty-state text. Re-derive display strings from the already-stored currentProduct; do NOT re-fetch and do NOT translate currentProduct.name/description/ingredients values.

product-detail.html: add data-i18n='detail.reviewsSubtitle' to

; data-i18n='detail.reviewCountZero' to #summary-count; data-i18n-attr='placeholder:detail.reviewPlaceholder' to the review

shared-components.js: add a local t(key, fallback) helper (mirror products.js). For the header/footer skeleton injected via innerHTML, prefer adding data-i18n/data-i18n-attr to the markup and call window.SugarI18n?.apply(this) after setting innerHTML. Route dynamic strings through t(): search placeholder->header.searchPlaceholder, 'Clear search'->header.clearSearch, aria-labels 'Sugar Bliss home'->header.home, 'Main navigation'->header.mainNav, 'Search products'->header.searchProducts, 'Product suggestions'->header.suggestions, 'Cart'/'Account' (reuse header.cart/header.account), 'Language / Ngôn ngữ'->header.langSwitch; search results: 'In stock'->search.inStock, 'Out of stock'->reuse products.outOfStock, 'Treat'->search.treatFallback, 'Sugar Bliss product'->products.defaultName, 'log in'->search.logIn, 'View ... details'->search.viewDetails; AI chat: 'Ask me anything...'->chat.inputPlaceholder, 'Close chat'->chat.close, 'Open AI Assistant'->chat.open, 'Message to Sugar Bliss Assistant'->chat.inputAria. Add window.addEventListener('sugarbliss:lang-changed', ...) to re-run the search-results and chat render paths. Leave the lang code button (EN/VI) as-is.

product-reviews.js: using the existing text(key, fallback) helper, ensure summary-count 0-state uses detail.reviewCountZero and any remaining status/error/validation literals route through text() reusing existing detail.review* keys. Keep star glyphs and ${rating}/5 aria as-is. Add a sugarbliss:lang-changed listener to re-render the summary text and write-review labels if not already handled by apply().
acceptance_criteria: Every key referenced by the new data-i18n/data-i18n-attr attributes and SugarI18n.translate calls in product-detail.js/html, shared-components.js, product-reviews.js exists in assets/js/i18n.js dictionary with both vi and en.

product-detail.js contains no user-facing hardcoded literal for favourite/saving/days/adding/added/fallbacks/errors; all route through SugarI18n.translate with a fallback (verified by grep leaving only glyphs/URLs/DB fields).

Toggling language on a product-detail page flips the expiration unit ('10 days' <-> '10 ngày'), favourite button, and fallback placeholders fully, while product name/description/ingredients (DB) stay unchanged.

Header search placeholder, nav/cart/account labels, footer, and AI chat widget translate on language toggle on every page; opening the header search dropdown shows 'In stock'/'Out of stock' in the active language.
The reviews block (subtitle, textarea placeholder, photo hint, submit button, count, validation messages) translates on toggle.
verification: From project/src/main/resources/static: Select-String -Path assets/js/i18n.js -Pattern '"detail.daysUnit"|"detail.saved"|"header.searchPlaceholder"|"chat.open"|"search.inStock"' returns each line (loop over the full new-key list).
Grep each edited JS (product-detail.js, shared-components.js, product-reviews.js) for textContent|innerText|innerHTML|placeholder|alert( literals and confirm only non-user-facing strings remain.
node --check assets/js/product-detail.js assets/js/shared-components.js assets/js/i18n.js assets/js/product-reviews.js if Node is on PATH; otherwise load each page and confirm no console error.
Manual: open product-detail.html and one other page, toggle VI<->EN via the header switch, confirm full translation and that DB content is untouched.
findings:
FEAT-001 complete. i18n.js: added all 54 new keys (detail.*, header.*, search.*, chat.*, cart.*, checkout.*, orders.*, profile.*, common.*, contact.loginToSubmit) each with vi+en, and UPDATED detail.rating to {vi:'Chạm vào sao để đánh giá:', en:'Tap a star to rate:'}. No keys renamed. i18n.js is the sole editor for the dictionary; FEAT-002 must NOT add/edit dictionary entries — all cart.*/checkout.*/orders.*/profile.*/common.*/contact.loginToSubmit keys it needs already exist here (see plan.md 'Dictionary additions').

HELPER PATTERN FOR FEAT-002 TO REUSE (copy exactly, do not invent new): each JS file defines a local `function t(key, fallback){ if(window.SugarI18n){const value=window.SugarI18n.translate(key); if(value!==null){return value;}} return fallback; }` and routes dynamic strings through t('namespace.key','English fallback'), plus registers window.addEventListener('sugarbliss:lang-changed', reRenderFn) to re-render dynamic strings. product-reviews.js uses its own `const text=(key,fallback)=>window.SugarI18n?.translate(key)||fallback;` — same idea. Note translate() returns null when key missing, so use a non-null fallback.

parameterized keys use {name}/{count} placeholders and are substituted with .replace('{name}', value) by the caller (see products.js resultCount, cart.qtyFor, profile.viewFavorite). i18n.js engine does NOT auto-substitute placeholders.

FILES EDITED: assets/js/i18n.js (dictionary), assets/js/product-detail.js (added t() helper + reRenderDetail(); favourite/saving/days/adding/added/fallbacks/errors routed through t(); related-products empty-state uses container.dataset.empty flag so reRenderDetail re-translates it without refetch; extended sugarbliss:lang-changed listener from syncProductAvailability to reRenderDetail), pages/product-detail.html (added data-i18n/data-i18n-attr: detail.reviewsSubtitle, detail.reviewCountZero on #summary-count, detail.reviewPlaceholder, detail.reviewPhotoHint, detail.submitReview, detail.reviewModalAlt), assets/js/shared-components.js (added module-level t() helper; header/footer/chat static strings carry data-i18n/data-i18n-attr and rely on existing apply(this) calls; search-result dynamic strings + chat input/aria routed through t()/data-i18n-attr; header lang-changed handler re-renders this.lastSuggestions; added SugarChatbox apply(this) + lang-changed listener + disconnectedCallback cleanup). product-reviews.js: NO edits needed - already fully uses text() helper, keeps star glyphs/${rating}/5, and already had a sugarbliss:lang-changed listener (render(state.product)); summary-count 0-state is covered by the new data-i18n='detail.reviewCountZero' in HTML (JS overwrites once reviews load via detail.reviewCount).

VERIFICATION: node --check passed on i18n.js/product-detail.js/shared-components.js/product-reviews.js; all 54 keys confirmed present with vi+en; node eval of the dictionary resolves vi/en for sampled keys and detail.rating EN='Tap a star to rate:'; grep confirms remaining literals in edited JS are only t() fallbacks, alert(error.message) (server/network messages), URLs, CSS classes, or ♥/♡/★/☆ glyphs. Manual browser language-toggle smoke test NOT performed (no browser in this environment) - that is the real behavioral gate per plan item 4 and should be run by the reviewer.

KNOWN GAPS left intentionally for this feature (report, do not half-fix inside FEAT-001): (a) admin pages/admin/*.html and assets/js/admin-*.js have no i18n wiring/switcher - out of scope; (b) shared-components.js chat operational strings NOT in FEAT-001's enumerated list remain English-only: chat greeting 'Hi! How can I help...', Send button, search-state messages ('Type at least 2 characters to search.', 'Searching products...', 'No matching products found.', 'Search is unavailable...'), the ' to search products.' suffix after the log-in link, chat error/timeout messages, 'Log in'/'Please log in to chat...' and chat product-card aria 'View {name} details'; (c) product-detail.js throws a VI internal error 'Không tìm thấy sản phẩm trong Database' surfaced via detail.errData prefix - string not enumerated in the plan; (d) brand <title>, numeric sample placeholders, and ♥/♡/★/☆ glyphs left as-is by design. Items (b)/(c) are candidates for a later sweep (plan item 10/11) if the reviewer wants full chat i18n.
